class.name: IfcApplication
class.brief_description: IfcApplication holds the information about an IFC compliant application developed by an application developer. The IfcApplication utilizes a short identifying name as provided by the application developer. HISTORY New entity in IFC R1.5.

members.member: Name of the application developer, being requested to be member of the IAI.
The version number of this software as specified by the developer of the application. A String, or null when unset.
The full name of the application as specified by the application developer. A String, or null when unset.
Short identifying name for the application. A String, or null when unset.
